# cursor

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/cursor"
```

Package cursor is a text field's caret on its own: it blinks, stays lit or hides, over the character it sits on, at the pace the theme sets.

<a name="BlinkMsg"></a>
## type [BlinkMsg](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/cursor/cursor.go#L39-L42>)

BlinkMsg flips the cursor whose ID it carries. A host hands it on the way it hands on keys; a cursor ignores every other cursor's.

```go
type BlinkMsg struct {
    ID int64
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="Mode"></a>
## type [Mode](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/cursor/cursor.go#L17>)

Mode is how a focused cursor shows.

```go
type Mode int
```

<a name="Blinking"></a>

```go
const (
    Blinking Mode = iota // lit and dark in turn, at the theme's CaretBlink
    Steady               // lit while focused
    Hidden               // never lit; the character shows plain
)
```

```go
func (m Model) Update(msg tea.Msg) (Model, tea.Cmd)
```

## type [Styles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/cursor/cursor.go#L45-L48>)

```go
}
```
